🐾 Welcome to PET RESCUE USA! 🇺🇸

We share powerful animal rescue, pet care, veterinary treatment, and recovery stories. From helping injured animals to removing parasites like botflies and ticks, our mission is simple: Rescue • Care • Heal • Love. ❤️

Our videos raise awareness about animal welfare and show why every animal deserves kindness, proper care, and a second chance.

🐶🐱 Subscribe and join us in giving animals hope!
PET RESCUE USA — Every Life Matters. 🐾🇺🇸

⚠️ Animal Care Disclaimer: Our content is created for educational and awareness purposes. Never attempt medical treatment or parasite removal on an animal yourself. Always seek help from a qualified veterinarian or animal-care professional.
